Marissa — sending the log snippet and short blurb now. Notes:

- We rotate ephemeral API keys via short-lived KMS leases (default TTL 1h). Lease creation is tied to a service token mint request; rotation occurs on renewal or on explicit revocation.
- Audit: each lease lifecycle event (create/renew/revoke) emits a telemetry event with lease_id, actor_id, and sha256(lease_public) to our observability pipeline; logs are forwarded to a retention-backed index for 90 days.
- Redaction: we sanitize actor_id and any user-identifying metadata in samples.

Putting items into evidence_manifest_stewards.csv under control mappings now.

— Jonas
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
